about: Test policies checked on each school's own admissions page. College Scorecard's test policy comes from federal reporting that lags behind schools' announcements, so a school listed here uses this instead. Add a school only with an official source.

source.title: Yale Undergraduate Admissions: standardized testing requirements

university-of-pennsylvania.note: Applicants who haven't taken the SAT or ACT and face hardship can ask for a waiver.

stanford-university.note: Required beginning with students who applied in fall 2025.

source.title: Stanford Report: Stanford to resume standardized test requirement (June 2024)

dartmouth-college.note: Required of applicants from U.S. high schools; students from high schools abroad have other options.

source.title: Dartmouth: FAQ on standardized testing reactivation
Johns Hopkins Undergraduate Admissions: standardized testing

california-institute-of-technology.note: Required beginning with applicants for fall 2025.

carnegie-mellon-university.note: Required for every college except the College of Fine Arts, which is test-optional.

university-of-north-carolina-at-chapel-h.note: Not required with a weighted GPA of 2.8 or higher. Below that, an ACT of 17 or higher or an SAT of 930 or higher is required.

source.title: Duke Undergraduate Admissions: resources and FAQs

texas-a-and-m-university-college-station.note: Applicants for spring and fall 2027 aren't affected by a proposed change that would require scores starting in 2028.

kennesaw-state-university.note: Applicants also need to meet minimum section scores set by the University System of Georgia.

source.title: U.S. Coast Guard Academy: admission requirements
University of Miami Admissions: testing policy

university-of-miami.note: Applicants to performance majors in the Frost School of Music, BFA programs and the School of Architecture, and students finishing high school outside the U.S., can apply without scores.

source.title: Ohio State Admissions: Columbus campus application steps

ohio-state-university-main-campus.note: Required for the Columbus campus. Not required if you will have been out of high school two or more years. Ohio State's regional campuses don't consider scores.

source.title: Georgia State Admissions: what to know about testing

georgia-state-university.note: Required for bachelor's degrees on the Atlanta campus. Perimeter College (associate degrees) admits students with at least a 2.0 GPA without scores.

georgia-southern-university.note: Required for traditional admission to the Statesboro and Armstrong campuses. University College admits students with at least a 2.0 GPA without scores.

source.title: Mercer University Admissions: college application tips

louisiana-state-university-and-agricultu.note: LSU does require scores if your weighted high school GPA is below 3.5.

source.title: University of Alabama Admissions: testing requirements

the-university-of-alabama.note: For fall 2027 entry, scores are required if your high school GPA is below 3.0. Starting with fall 2028 entry, everyone must send scores.

university-of-alabama-at-birmingham.note: For fall 2027 entry, scores are required if your weighted GPA is below 3.5. Starting with fall 2028 entry, everyone must send scores.

columbia-university-in-the-city-of-new-y.note: Optional for fall 2027 entry. Starting with fall 2028 entry (applications from August 2027), scores are required.

university-of-notre-dame.note: Optional for fall 2027 entry. Starting with fall 2028 entry, scores are required.

vanderbilt-university.note: Optional for fall 2027 and fall 2028 entry. Starting with fall 2029 entry, scores are required.

source.title: Princeton Alumni Weekly: Princeton admissions will again require standardized tests (October 2025)

princeton-university.note: Optional for students applying now. Students applying in fall 2027, for fall 2028 entry, will need to send scores.
